top_choice_rationale: Besley, Persson, and Tabellini made complementary, mature and consequential contributions to understanding how political institutions and incentives shape state capacity and fiscal policy. A narrowly bounded citation identifies their common institutional-fiscal achievement without treating them as representatives of all political economy.
recusal_note: No profile-based conflict with the proposed laureates is apparent. My disclosed co-authorship and institutional ties concern committee colleagues, not candidates in the top proposal.
